name: agentcn
summary: shadcn-style registry of 76 installable AI agent recipes for the Eve, Flue, Mastra and LangGraph frameworks.
description: A registry of complete, production-ready agent recipes — not a UI component registry: each recipe distributes the backend agent files (instructions, tools, skills, workflows) that you copy into your project with the shadcn CLI. 19 recipes are listed (Deep Search, AI SEO Audit, Extract DESIGN.md, Meeting Notes, Chat with PDF, Docs Chatbot, Chat with Database, GitHub PR Review, Slack Agent, Browser Agent, Weather …), each with a live preview and install paths for Eve, Flue, Mastra and LangGraph (Dawn). Recipes land in the paths each framework discovers automatically.
contains: 76 registry items; 19 recipes listed incl. Deep Search, AI SEO Audit, Extract DESIGN.md, Meeting Notes
recipes ship backend agent files (instructions, tools, skills, workflows), not UI components
installs via the shadcn CLI into Eve, Flue, Mastra or LangGraph (Dawn) project layouts
live previews embedded in each recipe's docs page
machine-readable extras: llms.txt, OpenAPI description, markdown mirrors, an agent skill
MIT licensed; free and open source
